titleEn: Can't Look into His Eyes Yet
summary: A military hearing decides whether Eren will be dissected, executed, or handed to the Survey Corps. Levi answers with violence, and Mikasa cannot look.

segments.ja: 審議の部屋は、法廷というより兵団の権力が見える広間でした。中央にダリス・ザックレーが座り、その下にエレン・イェーガーが鎖で固定されています。片手と片足は戻っていても、自由な人間の姿勢ではありません。ミカサ・アッカーマンとアルミンは、発言を許された席の端にいます。エレンは自分の名前を呼ばれるたびに、兵器の型番を呼ばれているように感じました。
segments.en: The hearing room looked less like a court than a hall where the regiments could see one another's power. Darius Zachary sat at the center. Below him, Eren Jaeger was fixed in place with chains. His hand and foot had grown back, and he still did not have the posture of a free person. Mikasa Ackerman and Armin sat at the edge of the seats allowed to speak. Each time Eren's name was called, it sounded to him like a weapon's model number.

tokens.note: The military hearing that decides who will have custody of Eren. The formal hearing, not a private conversation.

segments.ja: ナイール・ドクは、憲兵団の立場を短く述べます。予測できない巨人の力を、壁の内側に生かしておく理由はない。処分が最も安全だ、と。解剖して知識を取ってからでもいい、という冷たい追加もありました。ナイールはエレンを憎んでいる様子ではありません。リスクの計算として、彼を消すほうを選んでいます。その落ち着きが、怒りより怖く聞こえました。
segments.en: Nile Dok stated his regiment's position in a few sentences. There was no reason to keep an unpredictable Titan power alive inside the walls. Disposal was the safest course. A colder addition said they could dissect him first and keep the knowledge. Nile did not look as if he hated Eren. As a calculation of risk, he preferred erasure. That calm sounded more frightening than anger.

segments.en: The Garrison side brought out the sealing of Trost District. The fact that the hole was plugged was evidence that Eren could be used. Pyxis, without too much heat, said that yesterday's city was still here. Erwin of the Survey Corps spoke past that. Retaking Wall Maria would need the same power. Kill Eren, and that gate would not open again. Every argument came from a regiment's need, not from the fear inside the boy.

segments.ja: エレンは黙っているつもりでした。しかし処分と解剖の言葉が重なると、鎖の中で声が割れます。自分は人間だ、仲間を守るために戦った、殺すなら理由を言え、と。叫びは正しい内容でも、聞こえる形は巨人の脅威に近すぎました。広間の空気が一度に傾きます。味方だと述べた人たちも、この顔は見たくない、という目をしました。アルミンは止めに入りますが、言葉の速度が遅すぎます。
segments.en: Eren had meant to stay quiet. When the words disposal and dissection piled up, his voice cracked inside the chains. He was human. He had fought to protect his friends. If they were going to kill him, they should say why. The content was fair, and the shape of the shouting was too close to the threat of a Titan. The hall tilted all at once. Even people who had called him an ally looked as if they did not want this face. Armin moved to stop him, and the words were too slow.

segments.ja: 調査兵団の兵長、リヴァイが席を立ちます。彼は演説をしません。エレンの前に降り、短く、激しく、人間の暴力で彼を床に伏させます。歯が割れ、血が広間の石に落ちます。リヴァイが見せたのは、憎しみではなく制御です。この少年が巨人になっても、自分は殺せる。その証明を、ザックレーの前で体に刻みました。エレンは反論する力を、数秒で失います。
segments.en: Levi, Captain of the Survey Corps, stood up. He made no speech. He stepped down in front of Eren and, briefly and violently, put him on the floor with ordinary human force. A tooth broke. Blood hit the stone of the hall. What Levi showed was not hatred. It was control. Even if this boy became a Titan, Levi could kill him. He carved that proof into a body, in front of Zachary. In a few seconds Eren lost the strength to answer back.

segments.en: Mikasa's hand moved toward a blade, and Armin held her back. Her eyes followed Levi and would not go down as far as Eren's face. It was not only that she could not look yet. She knew that if she looked, she would stop being a soldier. The hall chose Levi's calm over her anger. After the blood, the air hardened into a decision. If he can be controlled, give him to the Survey Corps. Mikasa's being right was not part of the procedure.

segments.en: Zachary set disposal aside. Eren would be placed under the Survey Corps. The condition was simple. If he lost control, Levi would kill him. Erwin did not refuse the condition. He had only the result of being chosen.

segments.ja: 夜、エレンは腫れた口で水を飲みます。リヴァイは多くを話しません。殺す条件だけを、もう一度短い言葉で置いて去ります。エレンはその背中を、敵としても味方としても見切れません。ミカサがやっと扉の内側に入ったとき、彼は目を合わせようとして失敗します。まだ見れないのは、ミカサだけではありません。エレン自身も、今日の自分の顔を完全には認めたくありませんでした。
segments.en: At night Eren drank water through a swollen mouth. Levi did not say much. He set the condition for killing him down once more, in a short sentence, and left. Eren could not finish seeing that back as an enemy or as an ally. When Mikasa was finally allowed inside the door, he tried to meet her eyes and failed. She was not the only one who could not look yet. Eren himself did not want to fully accept the face he had worn today.

segments.ja: 審議の前、エレンは人の列のあいだを運ばれます。兵士も、壁の内の役人も、同じように足を止めます。見る目は二種類です。穴を塞いだ少年を見ようとする目と、いつ牙が出るかを測る目。ミカサはその両方を敵のように見返し、アルミンは彼女の肘を引きます。ここで一人を睨めば、審議の前に結論が作られる、と。エレンは頭を上げたまま歩きます。下げれば、処分を受け入れた顔になる気がしたからです。
segments.en: Before the hearing, Eren was carried between lines of people. Soldiers and officials from inside the walls stopped their feet in the same way. There were two kinds of eyes. Eyes trying to see the boy who plugged the hole, and eyes measuring when the fangs would show. Mikasa looked back at both as if they were enemies, and Armin pulled her elbow. Stare down one person here, and a conclusion would be built before the hearing. Eren walked with his head up. He felt that if he lowered it, his face would be the face of someone who had accepted disposal.

segments.en: After Levi's violence, the hall returned to numbers. Who would watch. Who would experiment. Who would kill him if it failed. Erwin offered Survey Corps people. Nile demanded Military Police oversight. Zachary gathered the compromise as procedure, not as feeling. The blood on the floor had not been wiped. Procedure moved even on top of blood. Through a swollen mouth Eren understood that the subject of the sentences had shifted from him to a thing to be managed. Mikasa's anger was left outside the trade.

segments.ja: 訓練兵たちの庭に、結果は噂の形で先に届きます。殺されなかった。調査兵団に渡された。リヴァイに殴られた。三つの文が、正確な順番を失って回ります。ジャンは三番目の文で足を止めます。制御のために仲間を殴れる兵団へ、自分は入れるのか。サシャはエレンが生きていることだけを繰り返し、コニーは笑おうとして失敗します。アルミンが後から正確な条件を伝えに来たとき、庭の空気はすでに、翼への距離を測り始めていました。
segments.en: In the cadets' yard the result arrived first as rumor. He was not killed. He was given to the Survey Corps. Levi beat him. Three sentences circulated and lost their accurate order. Jean stopped walking at the third sentence. Could he join a regiment that could beat a comrade for the sake of control. Sasha repeated only that Eren was alive. Connie tried to laugh and failed. When Armin came later to deliver the accurate conditions, the yard was already measuring its distance from the wings.

Eren checked the hurting tooth with his tongue, looked for an apology, and threw it away. Neither of them said that calculation. Until the cloth was red and the bucket water was cloudy, only the work continued. Trust was still absent. Care had come back first.

segments.ja: 今日の言葉です。審議は、エレンの扱いを決めた公式の場です。憲兵団は、壁の内側の秩序を優先し、処分を主張しました。解剖は、体を開いて力の仕組みを知る提案です。団長エルヴィンは、奪還のために調査兵団へ預ける案を出しました。兵長リヴァイは、制御できることを暴力で示しました。ザックレーは、その場をまとめた人です。まだ目を見れない、はミカサの状態であり、この話のタイトルでもあります。決定は下りました。信頼は、まだ下りていません。
segments.en: Today's words. The hearing was the official room that decided what to do with Eren. Nile's regiment put order inside the walls first and argued for disposal. Dissection was the proposal to open the body and learn how the power works. Commander Erwin offered to take him into the Survey Corps for the sake of retaking land. Captain Levi showed, with violence, that he could be controlled. Zachary was the person who closed the meeting. Not yet able to look him in the eyes is Mikasa's state, and it is also the title of this story. A decision came down. Trust did not.
